subject: maths
question: The cost price of an article is Rs. 650. After allowing a discount of 45%, a gain of 10% was made. Find the marked price of the article.
solution:
**Given:**

Cost price (CP) of an article = Rs. 650

Discount = 45%

Gain = 10%

**Formula Used:**

Marked Price (MP) = Selling Price (SP) / (1 - Discount%)

Selling Price (SP) = Cost Price (CP) × (1 + Gain%)
